requirements.requirement: The system must calculate years_in_practice using enumeration_date when graduation_year is not available by subtracting enumeration year from current year.
The system must calculate years_in_practice using graduation_year when available by subtracting graduation_year from current year.
The system must prioritize graduation_year over enumeration_date when both fields are available.
The system must ensure years_in_practice is a non-negative integer.
The system must compute normalized_experience_score based on predefined year ranges mapped to a 0–1 scale.
The system must assign the maximum normalized score when years_in_practice exceeds the highest defined range threshold.
The system must assign the minimum normalized score when years_in_practice is zero.
The system must round or floor fractional year calculations to the nearest whole integer.
The system must return null for years_in_practice and normalized_experience_score when both enumeration_date and graduation_year are missing.
The system must handle future-dated enumeration_date or graduation_year by returning null values for derived fields.
The system must correctly parse enumeration_date from NPI API response format into a valid date object before calculation.
The system must produce consistent years_in_practice outputs for identical input values across repeated executions.
The system must ensure normalized_experience_score is always within the inclusive range of 0 to 1.
The system must log a warning when fallback logic is used due to missing graduation_year or enumeration_date.
